suggestions.topic: Hegota headliner and EIP inclusion decisions based on client preference lists
suggestions.rationale: Client preference lists were due September 9 (24 hours before this call). This is the primary decision point for finalizing Hegota scope, with a target of completing scoping by DEVCON (November 3).

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam testnet fork dates confirmation (Sepolia Sep 28, Hoodi Oct 26)
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #244 proposed these dates pending ACDC confirmation. With Sepolia fork ~3 weeks away, final go/no-go decision is needed now to give ecosystem adequate notice.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam devnet-9 status and readiness for testnet graduation
suggestions.rationale: Devnet-9 (non-finality stress test, ~4 days) was launching as of ACDE #244. Status update is needed to confirm whether any issues surfaced that would affect testnet readiness or require another devnet iteration.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7928 BAL implementation divergence resolution (Hive chain PR #1589)
suggestions.rationale: Hive chain PR #1589 has been blocked since ACDE #242 due to client disagreement on EIP-7928 BAL contents at block 57. This is a Glamsterdam spec issue that should be resolved before testnet forks, but there's no evidence of progress since July 30.

suggestions.topic: eth_simulateV1 specification gaps and client alignment
suggestions.rationale: Clients disagree on simulated block contents per ACDE #244. This affects tooling and developer experience. Resolution via execution-apis issue #868 was requested but no update has been provided.

suggestions.topic: Ephemeral-contract / SELFDESTRUCT replacement EIP status (EIP-8360 placeholder)
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #244 set a 2-4 week deadline for championing a proper EIP to replace SELFDESTRUCT refill (rejected for Glamsterdam). EIP-8360 retained as placeholder. Champion deadline has now passed — need to confirm status or remove from Hegota scope.

suggestions.topic: Native AA (EIP-8141/8130) convergence update from weekly breakout sessions
suggestions.rationale: AA breakouts moved to weekly cadence (Tuesdays 14:00 UTC) as of late August to accelerate 8141/8130 convergence. EIP-8141 was SFI'd but spec may change. L2 teams raised DoS/TPS concerns. Update needed on whether shared tx type or dual tx type approach is emerging.

suggestions.topic: admin_nodeInfo ENR field implementation status for discv5-only mode
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #242 noted no EL client had implemented ENR fields in admin_nodeInfo yet, which is needed for discv5-only devnet support. Action item is now 5 weeks old with no confirmed progress, but this is a non-blocking feature for mainnet forks.
